title: Bat wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,32 62,32' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,20 56,20' fill='#ff6699'/>
  <polygon points='44,20 50,8 56,20' fill='#ff6699'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#ff3366'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='12' ry='3' fill='#ff6699'/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='45,22 55,22 53,26 47,26' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <polygon points='42,28 58,28 57,31 43,31' fill='#66ccff'/>

  <!-- Wings -->
  <path d='M28,50 Q10,42 6,55 Q12,62 20,58 Q24,64 30,60 Z' fill='#7a5c99'/>
  <path d='M28,50 Q14,46 10,54 Q14,58 20,55 Q24,58 28,56 Z' fill='#9b7cc4'/>
  <path d='M72,50 Q90,42 94,55 Q88,62 80,58 Q76,64 70,60 Z' fill='#7a5c99'/>
  <path d='M72,50 Q86,46 90,54 Q86,58 80,55 Q76,58 72,56 Z' fill='#9b7cc4'/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#5c3d7a'/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='34,42 28,26 42,36' fill='#5c3d7a'/>
  <polygon points='36,40 32,30 41,36' fill='#cc88dd'/>
  <polygon points='66,42 72,26 58,36' fill='#5c3d7a'/>
  <polygon points='64,40 68,30 59,36' fill='#cc88dd'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#6b4590'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='42' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='42' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='2' fill='#3b1f5c'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='43' r='2' fill='#3b1f5c'/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <polygon points='48,49 52,49 50,53' fill='#ff99cc'/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46,55 Q50,58 54,55' stroke='#ff99cc' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Fangs -->
  <polygon points='46,56 47,60 48,56' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <polygon points='52,56 53,60 54,56' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='49' r='3' fill='#cc66aa' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='49' r='3' fill='#cc66aa' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='77' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#5c3d7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='77' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#5c3d7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='77' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#9b7cc4'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='77' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#9b7cc4'/>
</svg>
